notes: Choose candidate family by mean scaffold CV score using train labels only.
Evaluate a fixed 25 percent blend against the submitted v4 on official valid only after family selection.
MAE and Spearman, or AUROC and AUPRC, must both avoid regression in observed valid for a provisional pass.

CV scores compare new candidate families, not the full historical v4 ensemble.
A provisional pass is not a blind-test or platform-score guarantee.
No test labels, auxiliary assay labels, external ADMET labels or test-target lookup.
The frozen external encoder is a masked-language-model checkpoint, not an ADMET fine-tuned checkpoint.
